residual_risks.description: The system may faithfully execute bad goals if higher-level goals are poorly framed.
Reality divergence catches model mismatch, but not every form of novel environment change instantly.
Phase 46 hardens intent protocol, but humans can still formulate bad or confused legitimate intents.
Utility weights and strategic posture logic may still reflect imperfect preferences even when safely enforced.
Institutional memory is advisory-only, but long-horizon summaries can still subtly bias search priorities over time.
